reason: AUDITED, NO REDIRECT ADDED. Both / and /index.html are live, separately-resolvable URLs on GitHub Pages (confirmed via curl: both return HTTP 200 with identical content and matching ETag). This is expected static-hosting behavior (GitHub Pages always serves a directory's index.html both at the directory path and at the literal index.html path) and is not specific to this site or a sign of drift. layouts/partials/head.html already emits <link rel="canonical"> and og:url stripped of a trailing index.html (see $canonicalURL), and layouts/sitemap.xml already lists only the stripped form in <loc>, so search engines are already pointed at / as the single indexed URL. A Hugo aliases: redirect would only generate a *new* static page at an alias path -- it cannot change how GitHub Pages already serves the pre-existing index.html file, so it is not a usable or necessary tool for this case. Per the issue's explicit instruction not to perform a blanket redirect based on the /index.html observation alone, and per the absence of any evidence of duplicate-content/ranking harm (canonical+sitemap already converge on one URL), no redirect is added for this pair.

reason: AUDITED, NO REDIRECT ADDED (DELETIONS, NOT MOVES). Issue #65 trimmed 10 blog posts to a max of 3 tags each, per explicit maintainer-authored recommendations in the issue thread. These ~24 tag values were dropped entirely (no other post uses them), so Hugo stops generating their auto-built /tags/<slug>/ taxonomy pages. Each was a single-post, auto-generated listing page (not authored content) consisting only of that one post's title/summary/date -- e.g. a release-number tag (7.4.1), a law/regulation acronym (GDPR, DSGVO), a install/how-to fragment already covered by the post's own page, or a locale-specific word replaced by a more discoverable, deliberately-chosen synonym in the same post (e.g. hr's "hrvatska" was kept, but "župni softver"/"bosna-hercegovina" were not re-added). None were the canonical destination for other content, none carry known backlinks, and each post itself remains fully reachable at its own permalink -- only the narrow single-post tag-listing page disappears. Per seo-audit-methodology.md's Phase 4 framework (fix only with evidence of ranking harm; otherwise leave as-is / no redirect needed) and redirect-strategy.md (a redirect requires a successor URL -- there is none here, this is a removal, not a migration), no alias/redirect was added. Tags that merely changed capitalization (e.g. "hrvatska"->"Hrvatska", "português"->"Português", "migration"->"Migration", "self-hosted"->"Self-Hosted", "open-source"->"Open Source") were NOT deleted: Hugo lowercases taxonomy slugs, so the existing /tags/<slug>/ page persists unchanged under the same URL. Verified against the actual `hugo --minify` build output (public/tags/) that every page listed here is absent post-change and every case-only-changed page is still present.
